music.name: Chinonegro, Sebastian Fox, Que Lindo

music.name: Contra & Abstrakt Sonance
music.address: 420 S. First St, San Jose, CA

music.summary: Mighty Heavy presents Contra with Abstrakt Sonance, Wompsta and Darkstar at Guildhouse in downtown San Jose. Bass music, 21+, 9pm to 1:30am.

music.name: House Revolution: Poe, DJ Crew, Otter
music.why: A pure, house-only dancefloor focused on tight DJ sets.

sports.name: Lake to Ocean: A Nature Walk

sports.why: For golden-hour ocean and city views, wildlife spotting, and an easy paved group walk.

Typical route follows Lake Merced up to the Fort Funston observation deck with ocean and city views, or alternately goes past the zoo to Sunset Dunes; paths are fully paved.

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Tuesday)
sports.address: 2450 Harrison St, San Francisco, CA
sports.why: Play a free pickup squash game and meet local players.

sports.name: San Francisco Bike Party (First Fridays)

sports.name: Golden Gate Park Sunday Roller Disco Party (SF)

sports.name: SF's Free "Sundays at the Beach" Chair Yoga Day (Great Highway)

sports.name: When was the last time you played catch?

sports.summary: A free, casual play‑catch meetup at Marina Green where people toss baseballs, softballs, footballs, or volleyballs—no teams or pressure, just conversation.

sports.name: Golden State Warriors vs. Utah Jazz
sports.why: For live pro basketball and the arena atmosphere.

sports.name: San Francisco - Thursday Pickup Spikeball

sports.address: 1901 Geary Blvd, San Francisco, CA 94115, USA, San Francisco, CA

sports.name: Squash in the Mission (Saturday)

sports.name: Fog City Run 5K

sports.name: Sundays Pick-Up Soccer in Marina Green
